title: Use resolved Body arc-length cache during appearance projection
description: Remove the per-vertex prefix walk over Body segment lengths from BodyVerticalGradientSampler. Use ResolvedBody.NormalizedArcLengthAtSample, which already represents the authoritative cumulative parameterization, and preserve exact head/tail orientation semantics.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Implemented in commit 945d3b6b02f4d61a69ee4d0d8e7530c521558158. The closest segment now interpolates the resolved normalized arc-length endpoints instead of summing prior segments per vertex. Unity runtime validation remains pending.
